scope: production promotion of the exact development-tested artifacts
authorization.stageControl: Root coordinates release stages. A source/documentation commit is not evidence that remote CI, deployment or production verification has completed.

consumerPinInstructions.target: Resolve self to the immutable SHA of the Landing commit containing this evidence. Put that exact 40-character SHA in each consumer docs/help/contract.json.
consumerPinInstructions.noSelfReferenceCycle: Do not rewrite this Landing commit merely to insert its own SHA. Consumer contracts are the evidence of their final pin; Landing retains self.

requiredReleaseGates: Exact runtime source bytes must match the three recorded checkpoints.
API full validation must succeed before PR readiness; root owns the independent Go suite and its evidence.
All affected service help contracts must pass against the actual pinned Landing commit, not only a mutable workspace.
Make the Admin source checkpoint reachable on GitHub before Landing CI checks its ui-evidence.ref.
Keep one PR into develop per affected repository; no routine main synchronization.
Verify development API support revision, Web campaign capabilities and Admin behavior; publish the three-language guides with the compatible UI.
Promote the exact successful development artifacts without rebuilding, then verify production and the public support/documentation revision.
